title: Isiphethu
metaTitle: Isiphethu Brand Identity — Case Study | Santi Universe
description: Isiphethu Group Holdings brand identity and guidelines, with a blue visual system and six concept mockups for corporate and field applications.

hero.alt: Isiphethu logo presented on an office reception wall
hero.caption: Reception · concept mockup

chapters.label: Context
heading: One group.
A connected identity.
text: Isiphethu operates across construction, engineering and water services. Its identity needs to remain recognisable across corporate communications and practical, everyday applications.
The brand guide brings the core elements together: logo construction, clear space, colour, typography and usage rules. The aim is a consistent presentation wherever the brand appears.

images.alt: Isiphethu master logo with sweeping blue symbol and italic wordmark
images.caption: Master identity · from the brand guide

chapters.label: The system
heading: Precision in
every detail.
text: A flowing blue symbol sits beside a distinctive italic wordmark. The guide defines how that relationship is protected through consistent proportions, clear space and minimum sizes.
Navy provides depth, mid-blue carries the primary colour, and pale blue creates contrast. Ubuntu and Montserrat are named as supporting typefaces in the guide.

images.caption: Logo construction

images.alt: Ubuntu and Montserrat typography specifications in the brand guide
images.caption: Typography

chapters.label: Corporate communication
heading: Clear. Considered.
Recognisably Isiphethu.
text: The guide sets out a direct, clear voice, supported by values including teamwork, integrity, knowledge, reliability and innovation.
The stationery and company-profile concepts explore that identity in print, giving the logo room to stand out against clean surfaces and restrained blue details.

images.alt: Isiphethu stationery concept with letterhead, folder, cards and pen
images.caption: Stationery · concept mockup

chapters.label: Beyond the office
heading: An identity
that travels.
text: A vehicle, workwear and a ceramic mug extend the visual system into everyday contexts. Each application keeps the logo legible and the palette consistent.
chapters.note: The six application images on this page are concept mockups. They illustrate potential uses of the identity, rather than documenting a completed rollout.

chapters.label: A brand family
heading: Related services.
A shared foundation.
text: The guide also documents logo reconstruction studies for Engineering and Water Service. These explore how service-specific symbols can sit alongside the Isiphethu name.
They are presented here as development work from the guide, with the master identity providing the common foundation.
